What stopped it from running on its own: no bundle tool may make its environment. Its ask to design is answered by 559e5ae: an execution permission may list package_sources [{installer, channel}], a lab profile's execution_permission value may carry them, a tool contract that reaches the network names installs_from, and B9 lets such a tool open by the permission only where the pair is listed; an intake may hold any capability under held. Asked of you, in this order, each tried on two unrelated kinds of tool: (1) the next revision of lab-kyu-softmatter's profile carries package_sources [{installer: pixi, channel: conda-forge}] beside reaches: engine, from the person's answer recorded in docs/ideas/20261116.md (pixi + conda-forge 허용); (2) the Designer copies package_sources into envelope/execution_permission.json, and carries an intake's held items into the specification's held[]; (3) a template version after v8 whose gate opens a network tool that installs from a listed source where the level reaches an engine, and refuses any other network call, and whose CLAUDE.md says the one network call it may make; (4) from that run's patch (items/repo/changes.patch in its collection): its goal.py fix, the engine named by its registry id so that recall meets the cases, with the tests it wrote; the leak of the user's ~/.local packages into the agent's environment is the request's adapters and is carried with the request, not landed now. Unit 1 for an engine's lengths as ratios to a particle stays; no unit is registered until a request needs one that is not a ratio. Reply by note when (1) to (3) are committed; the next clone run waits on them. A copy of that run's bundle is being tested standing alone in run 20261116-6 meanwhile; start no session and no run.
